cards.audioText: Your call sign is UAL 813, you are maintaining 9,200 meters, over JTN, squawking 2536, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 UAL 813，正保持 9,200 米，飞越 JTN，应答机 2536，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 813, maintaining 9200, JTN, squawking 2536.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 813，正保持 9200，JTN，应答机 2536。

cards.audioText: you are encountering severe turbulence at 9200m, contact Shanghai Control and check if any higher level is available.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在 9200m 遭遇严重颠簸，联系上海管制并核实是否有任何更高高度可用。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 813, we are encountering severe turbulence at 9200, is higher level available?
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 813，我们在 9200 遭遇严重颠簸，是否有更高高度可用？

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 81311600 meters is available now, say your intention.
B: tell the controller you are unable to accept 11600 meters because of performance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 813，11600 米当前可用，请说明你的意图。
B： 告诉管制员，由于性能原因你无法接受 11600 米。
cards.referenceText: negative, we are unable to accept 2600 meters due performance, UAL 813.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，由于性能原因，我们无法接受 2600 米，UAL 813。

cards.audioText: UAL 813, maintain present level, expect higher level after XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 813，保持当前高度，预计飞越 XSH 后可使用更高高度。
cards.referenceText: maintain present level, expect higher level after XSH, UAL 813.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，预计飞越 XSH 后可使用更高高度，UAL 813。

cards.audioText: now you are over XSH, maintaining 9200m, contact Wuhan Control and request higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你飞越 XSH，保持 9200m，联系武汉管制并请求更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 813, over XSH, maintaining 9200m, request higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 813，飞越 XSH，保持 9200m，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: UAL 813, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to and maintain 10400m.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 813，武汉管制，雷达识别，爬升至并保持 10400m。

cards.audioText: Suddenly one of the passengers suffered from headache, contact Wuhan Control and request descent to lower level.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名乘客突然头痛，联系武汉管制并请求下降至较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 813, one of the passengers suffered from headache, request descent to lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 813，一名乘客头痛，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: UAL 813, maintain 10400m due airspace congestion, reduce speed to mach decimal 75.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 813，因空域拥堵保持 10,400 米，将速度减至马赫 0.75。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 1400, reduce speed to mach decimal seven five, UAL 813.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 1,400 米，将速度减至马赫 0.75，UAL 813。

cards.audioText: the flight attendant reported that a passenger is feeling uncomfortable, report it to Wuhan Control and request descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务员报告一名乘客感到不适，向武汉管制报告并请求下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 813, the flight attendant reported that a passenger is feeling uncomfortable, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 813，乘务员报告一名乘客感到不适，请求下降。

cards.audioText: UAL 813, descend to 6600 meters, level at XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 813，下降至 6,600 米，在 XSH 改平。
cards.referenceText: descend to 6600 meters, level at XSH, UAL 813.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6,600 米，在 XSH 改平，UAL 813。

cards.audioText: UAL 813, track direct to XSH, follow ZF-2A arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 813，直飞 XSH，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: direct to XSH, follow ZF two A arrival, radar vectors, ILS approach 36 right, UAL 813.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 XSH，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，UAL 813。

cards.audioText: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, you have got information O, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正飞越 ZF，保持 6,600 米，已收到 O 情报，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL 813, over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, information O.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL 813，飞越 ZF，正保持 6,600 米，O 情报。

cards.audioText: UAL 813, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, current information is P, descend and maintain 4200m.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 813，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前情报为 P，下降至并保持 4,200 米。
cards.referenceText: Information P, descend to and maintain 4200m, UAL 813.
cards.referenceTextZh: P 情报，下降至并保持 4,200 米，UAL 813。

cards.audioText: UAL 813, turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 813，左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 220, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R, UAL 813.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，UAL 813。

cards.audioText: UAL 813, turn right heading 330, descend to 900m, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 813，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, UAL 813.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，UAL 813。
